tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find available Almirall MCP tools by name, purpose, or input. Supply a non-empty query describing the tool or task, for example {"query":"search indexed content"}. Returns matching tool definitions. Use the MCP tools/list method to discover the complete catalog.

query.description: Required non-empty words describing the tool or task, for example 'search indexed content'.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Primary tool for answering natural-language questions over indexed website and landing-page content. Use this whenever the user asks what a brand, product, or site says about ingredients, plant extracts, composition, contraindications, usage, benefits, claims, FAQs, or evidence. This includes questions that only mention a brand or product name, for example 'What ingredients or plant extracts does Physio Relax mention?'. Call this tool directly with the question even if domain or sourceId are unknown; those fields are optional narrowing filters, not required inputs. If you need to discover or disambiguate the indexed domain or sourceId for a second narrowed call, use list_sources. Searches content with keyword, semantic, and vector search, and can filter by domain, url, sourceId, or documentId. Results are indexed chunks: reuse a returned uid unchanged with get_chunk, or its documentId and chunkIndex together; reuse a returned url or documentId with get_page for the page. Do not invent missing identifiers. If no search results are found, the tool returns only a no-results text message in the query language when it can be detected. Use that message as the entire user-facing answer while preserving its meaning. The final answer must explicitly say that no sufficient information or indexed mention was found in Almirall's public content for the query, avoid confirming unsupported details, and suggest another question or Almirall's official channels. When this no-results message is returned, stop and do not add counts, bullet lists, related products, examples, search traces, or conclusions from auxiliary tool calls. Do not summarize, explain, or replace it with an unrelated response.

query.description: Natural-language question or keywords to search in crawled website content.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

url.description: Optional exact crawled page URL filter.

documentId.description: Optional crawler document id to restrict results to one indexed page/document.

preferredLanguage.description: Optional preferred language tag (for example es, en, or de). The value is echoed in the response as a client hint; indexed result text remains in its source language.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to the server setting.

tools.name: get_chunk
tools.description: Retrieve an indexed chunk. Prefer the exact uid returned by search_content; alternatively provide documentId and chunkIndex. Search first if you have no fragment reference. Use sourceId and domain to restrict the lookup. Context contains adjacent chunks only.

uid.description: Preferred. Exact chunk uid returned by search_content.

sourceId.description: Optional source id used to scope the lookup, for example ciclopoli-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase.

chunkIndex.description: Chunk position within the document. Zero is valid.

contextBefore.description: Number of previous chunks to include. Defaults to 0.

contextAfter.description: Number of following chunks to include. Defaults to 0.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve an indexed page using its exact url or documentId. If you do not have a page reference, use search_content or list_pages first, then pass the returned url or documentId. Returns chunks ordered by chunkIndex plus a compact heading structure.

documentId.description: Exact document identifier returned by search_content or list_pages.

url.description: Exact page URL returned by search_content or list_pages.

sourceId.description: Optional source id filter, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum chunks to return. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: get_source_map
tools.description: Build a navigable map of an indexed source or domain with pages, documents, headings, and chunk ranges.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum chunks to inspect for the map. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List indexed pages available within a sourceId or domain. Each page has a url and may have documentIds; reuse a returned url or an entry from documentIds unchanged with get_page. This lists pages, not chunk uids.

query.description: Optional search query to narrow page discovery. Use * or omit for broad discovery.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum chunks to inspect for page discovery. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Discovery tool for indexed brands, sites, and domains. Use this when you need to discover or disambiguate which indexed domain/sourceId corresponds to a brand or product name, especially if an initial broad search needs narrowing. search_content does not require domain or sourceId, so prefer calling list_sources as an optional discovery step rather than as a mandatory prerequisite. It helps determine whether this MCP has a relevant indexed source and which domain or sourceId to pass into search_content or other tools.

query.description: Optional query to list sources related to a topic. Use * or omit for broad source discovery.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum chunks to inspect for source discovery. Defaults to 30.

skip.description: Number of matching chunks to skip before collecting the next page of sources. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: find_pages_by_title
tools.description: Resolve the most relevant indexed pages by approximate title match before doing a narrower content search. Use this when the user mentions a brand, product family, or page-like concept but not a domain or URL, and you want to identify the right page first without requiring an exact title match.

titleQuery.description: Brand, product, or page title hint to match approximately against indexed page titles.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id to narrow title matching.

domain.description: Optional domain filter to narrow title matching. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase.

top.description: Maximum number of candidate pages to return. Defaults to 10.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

tools.name: compare_content
tools.description: Find grouped evidence for comparing two to five distinct named items, product formats, ranges, topics, or alternatives. Provide their names as strings, for example {"items":["Almax Forte","Almax 500 mg"],"query":"format"}. If names are unknown, discover them with find_product_mentions, search_content or list_pages first. Do not invent names. Each item is searched independently; verify the evidence belongs to the named item and report missing information rather than inferring it. This tool does not resolve exact URLs or documentIds as references.

items.description: Two to five distinct non-empty names of items or topics, supplied by the user or discovered via find_product_mentions, search_content or list_pages; not URLs or documentIds.

query.description: Optional aspect to compare, such as ingredients, benefits, usage, format or contraindications.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

topPerItem.description: Maximum number of search results to keep per item. Defaults to 3.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

tools.name: find_product_mentions
tools.description: Specialized product extraction tool. Use when the user specifically asks what products a crawled brand/site offers, asks for catalog items, variants, product ranges, formulations, product benefits, ingredients by product, or where product claims appear. If the user is asking a general content question rather than enumerating products, use search_content instead. sourceId and domain are optional filters; if you need to discover the right indexed source before narrowing, use list_sources. Returns grouped product mentions with evidence snippets and real page URLs.

query.description: Natural-language query describing the product, brand, category, or benefit to detect.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

productHint.description: Optional known product or brand name to bias extraction and grouping.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum number of search results to inspect for product mentions. Defaults to at least 8.

tools.name: find_content_assets
tools.description: Extract image/media asset URLs from indexed markdown text. Use only when the user asks for product images, media files, visual assets, screenshots, WordPress uploads, or image evidence. For textual questions about extracted page content, use search_content instead. Returns asset URLs plus the real page URL where each asset appeared.

query.description: Optional topic, product, filename, or asset context to search before extracting assets. Defaults to image/product-oriented search.

url.description: Optional exact crawled page URL filter.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

domain.description: Optional domain filter. A leading www. is removed and the domain is normalized to lowercase; for example, www.ciclopoli.de resolves to ciclopoli.de.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

top.description: Maximum number of chunks to inspect for assets. Defaults to at least 10.

tools.name: match_almax_prompt
tools.description: Classify a Spanish prompt or phrase related to Almax into the closest editorial intent from the corpus. Use this when the client needs to detect which predefined Almax topic a user sentence matches before routing to another tool or template.

text.description: Phrase, prompt, or user text to classify.

tools.name: get_almax_dosage_calculator
tools.description: Calculate daily almagate grams for a standard dose of a supported Almax presentation and check the leaflet's age, 8 g/day and 14-day limits. daily_doses_intended means administrations per day, not tablets or sachets. This checks label limits only; it cannot establish individual clinical safety. treatment_days is needed to check duration.

product_variant.description: Almax presentation. forte_comprimidos uses the 750 mg tablet leaflet; one standard dose is two tablets.

daily_doses_intended.description: Number of standard administrations per day; the standard dose size is determined by product_variant.

treatment_days.description: Planned number of days. Omit only if unknown; then the 14-day limit cannot be assessed.

tools.name: get_official_prospecto
tools.description: Return the indexed Markdown text of a prospectus PDF published on Almax.com for an explicit presentation, with the original PDF URL. This uses Almirall's indexed content and does not independently check the current AEMPS version.
